title: Se fue la luz
goal: Get the power back, and learn it is not just your house
culture: The first question is never how to fix it, it is how far it goes. Your house alone is your problem; the whole block is the company’s. And somebody has to ring it in, which everybody assumes somebody else has already done.

beats.good: Se fue la luz — the light went. The verb is irse, as though it had walked out, which after the third time in a week is how it feels.

beats.es: A mí también, desde hace rato.
beats.good: This is the diagnostic question and it changes what happens next. Your house is your problem; the block is somebody else’s.

beats.es: En toda. Hasta la esquina está oscuro.
beats.objective: Ask whether anybody has rung it in
beats.good: Somebody has to report it and everybody assumes somebody else did. Asking is how you find out that nobody has.

beats.es: Sí, ya llamaron. Ya viene la cuadrilla.
beats.good: Ya viene means it is on its way and commits nobody to a time. You will hear it about the bus, the plumber, the rain and the light.
